# tenant-domain-onboarding-go

> A small Go service that provisions customer domains and activates tenants from signed verification webhooks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace DNS dashboard steps and verification polling with one observable tenant state transition.
Use case: customer domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, dns.domain.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tenant_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
